next_recommendation: TF-IDF 174k evaluation FROZEN as production baseline. 8/8 representations PASS both adversarial gates (language dominance threshold 0.85, jurist pairwise preference). Primary production mode: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.7345, LangDom=0.4773). Dense embedding complementary views acceptance criteria DEFINED and VALIDATED at available scales: (1) Citation Heritage: center_projected_64dim AUC > 0.75 — PASSED at 22yr/144k (0.7922) and 24yr/158k (0.7667); (2) Cross-Lingual Sachverhalt: center_projected_64dim cross_lang_same_branch > 0.2 — PASSED at 1K sample (0.2816); (3) Cross-Lingual Dispositiv: center_projected_64dim cross_lang_same_branch > 0.1 — PASSED at 1K sample (0.1502); (4) Linear Hybrid Complement: PASS both adversarial gates at optimal weight (w=0.3-0.4) with cross-lingual improvement over TF-IDF baseline — PASSED at 19-22yr. Erwaegungen cross-lingual FAILS threshold (0.094 < 0.1). Full 174k dense validation BLOCKED on corpus lane: BGE/bger ID mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction at 174k. No further same-question cycles justified.

critical_findings.tfidf_174k_baseline_frozen: 8 TF-IDF representations evaluated at full 173,963 decisions. ALL PASS both adversarial gates (language dominance < 0.85, jurist pairwise preference > 0.5). Best production mode: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.7345, LangDom=0.4773). Cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.714, LangDom=0.479) and cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (JP=0.7275, LangDom=0.478) also PASS. Other metrics (cross-language retrieval, hierarchy coherence, cluster coherence, boilerplate resistance) mostly FAIL — expected for flat embeddings; hierarchical modes address this in fractal-map lane.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_acceptance: Dense center_projected_64dim AUC > 0.75 threshold PASSED at 22yr/144k (AUC=0.7922, 344 positive pairs) and 24yr/158k (AUC=0.7667, 730 positive pairs). Superior to TF-IDF citation baseline (AUC 0.71-0.74) and TF-IDF text baseline (AUC 0.50-0.63). Raw 768dim FAILS at 24yr (AUC=0.682) — center projection REQUIRED. Minimal sufficient scale: 21yr/137k (AUC=0.8182).
critical_findings.cross_lingual_sachverhalt_acceptance: center_projected_64dim cross_lang_same_branch = 0.2816 > 0.2 threshold (PASS). Invariance gap = 0.187 (vs raw 768dim gap 0.304). Sample: 359 decisions with sachverhalt section. Sachverhalt (facts) aligns BEST cross-lingually. Full corpus validation BLOCKED on section extraction at 174k.
critical_findings.cross_lingual_dispositiv_acceptance: center_projected_64dim cross_lang_same_branch = 0.1502 > 0.1 threshold (PASS). Invariance gap = 0.397 (vs raw 768dim gap 0.575). Sample: 538 decisions with dispositiv section. Dispositiv (holdings) INTERMEDIATE cross-lingual alignment. Full corpus validation BLOCKED on section extraction at 174k.
critical_findings.cross_lingual_erwaegungen_failure: center_projected_64dim cross_lang_same_branch = 0.0941 < 0.1 threshold (FAIL). Invariance gap = 0.452 (vs raw 768dim gap 0.538). Sample: 510 decisions with erwaegungen section. Erwaegungen (reasoning) is MOST language-specific section. Hierarchy confirmed: Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen.
critical_findings.linear_hybrid_complement_acceptance: At 22yr/144k: linear_citation_concat_w0.4 (JP=0.6725, LangDom=0.6539) and outcome_hybrid_0.5_w0.3 (JP=0.6115, LangDom=0.7477) BOTH PASS adversarial gates. Cross-lingual improvement over TF-IDF baseline: +0.16. But JP REMAINS BELOW TF-IDF baseline (0.73-0.79). Marked EXPLORATORY — not primary navigation.
critical_findings.data_blockers: BGE/bger ID mapping missing (cannot align 174k dense embeddings with evaluation metadata); parquet 2022-2026 missing (29,520 decisions); section extraction at 174k not computed (sachverhalt/erwaegungen/dispositiv). All require corpus lane resumption.
